task.instructions: Which single task category best matches what the user is asking for?

criteria.general: Request involves: question, explain, brainstorm, summarize, overview, advice.
criteria.coding: Request involves: code, bug, debug, refactor, function, error, stack trace.
criteria.analysis: Request involves: analyze, evaluate, trade-offs, multi-step, reasoning, plan.
criteria.writing: Request involves: essay, email, rewrite, edit text, blog post.
criteria.research: Request involves: latest, news, sources, compare prices. Needs fresh or web-sourced information with sources.
criteria.math: Request involves: proof, equation, olympiad, derive.
criteria.multimodal: Request involves: image, photo, video, audio, screenshot. Understanding or analyzing an existing image, photo, video, audio or screenshot the user provides.
criteria.long_docs: Request involves: long document, transcript, contract, uploaded file, paper. Working over a long or uploaded document, transcript, contract or paper.
criteria.chinese: Request involves: chinese, 中文, translate to chinese, bilingual.
criteria.extraction: Request involves: classify, extract, tag, label, high volume. Classifying, extracting, tagging or labeling content, often in high volume.
criteria.image_generation: Request involves: generate image, create image, draw, illustration, logo, poster. Creating a brand-new image from a description.
criteria.image_editing: Request involves: edit image, edit photo, remove background, replace object, change the style of this image, retouch, inpaint, extend image. Modifying an existing image.
criteria.video_generation: Request involves: generate video, create video, animate, clip, motion. Creating a brand-new video from a description or image.
criteria.video_editing: Request involves: edit video, edit this clip, change the video, restyle video, remove from video, replace in video. Modifying an existing video clip.
criteria.audio_generation: Request involves: text to speech, voiceover, narrate, music, song. Creating speech, narration, music or songs.

model.instructions: Which model is the best fit for this request, considering the task, how difficult it is, and whether it needs reasoning?
